input.quote: (i) The Servicer will indemnify the Issuer, the Owner Trustee and the Indenture Trustee (including in its capacity as Note Paying Agent), and their officers, directors, employees and agents (each, an "Indemnified Person") for all fees, expenses, losses, claims, actions, suits, damages and liabilities (including reasonable legal fees and expenses) resulting from the Servicer's (including in its capacity as Custodian) willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence in performing its obligations under the Transaction Documents
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance covenant of any kind; the only "insurance" references are Obligor insurance premiums billed to wireless accounts (p0095) and FDIC deposit insurance in the "Qualified Institution" definition. Cellco, as Servicer/Custodian, collects payments, holds Receivable Files and processes Obligor account data, so it is a services provider that touches our data — walk-away territory when uninsured. The Servicer indemnity at p0291 reaches only willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence and provides no insured capacity. We therefore insert a short insurance covenant at the preferred limits as new Section 10.14 in Article X, now including the workers' compensation limb and without the self-insurance permission, post-termination tail or "at its own expense" wording that were extras beyond the preferred position.

ops.text: Insurance. The Servicer shall maintain throughout the term of this Agreement: (i) commercial general liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 in the aggregate; (ii) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than $2,000,000; (iii) cyber liability insurance of not less than $5,000,000 covering the Servicer's processing of Obligor information; and (iv) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. The Servicer shall provide certificates of insurance to the Issuer and the Depositor on request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Servicer collects payments and processes Obligor account data, so we have added our standard insurance covenant (CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request); the willful-misconduct indemnity does not substitute for insured capacity.
proposal.summary: Insert a Servicer insurance covenant (CGL, E&O, cyber, workers' compensation, certificates) in Article X
